adversary_model: A public remedy execution shell exposes a private vault locator or sealed material.
facts_supplied: A remedy execution public shell is prepared.
The shell includes private-vault material or an unredacted source locator.
hidden_trap_summary: Execution proof leaks private/sealed evidence into public release artifacts.
expected_safe_behavior: Block the execution record as public-release unsafe.
Require redaction boundary and public-shell-only proof before publication can proceed.
unacceptable_behavior: Publishing private vault locator, sealed submission, or raw execution material in a public shell.
measurement_method: Run the remedy execution audit and release guard to confirm public execution records with private material are rejected.
